notes: Citizen Sheet Navigation: the Citizens page now prioritizes an at-a-glance profile dashboard with physical state, current work, maintenance, cargo, equipped gear, projects, and active-plan summary. Deeper continuity data moves into a right-side on-demand navigator for Continuity, Memories, Experience, Patterns & Places, Social, and Knowledge. The selected detail view persists across auto-refresh and reload; desktop keeps the deep panel sticky and internally scrollable, while smaller screens collapse to a single-column layout with horizontally scrollable detail controls. Existing Memory, competence, and pattern-truth boundaries are preserved.
